steps.instruction: Load the persistent work state from `artifacts/<kb-ref>/work-state.json`.
If the stop criteria in [references/stop-criteria.md](references/stop-criteria.md) already fire, stop.

Otherwise run exactly one phase:
   discovery if the next phase is discovery,
   prove if the next phase is prove.
After the phase, refresh the plausibility report again.
If the auto-meta trigger fires, generate `meta-reflection-report.*`.
Persist the updated work state and next phase.
